title: ZeroR@CHiPSAL 2026：基于对比学习的尼泊尔模因分类两阶段视觉语言适配
summary: 本文介绍CHiPSAL 2026共享任务中尼泊尔模因多模态仇恨言论与情感分析系统。采用Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct，两阶段训练：LoRA微调生成分类与对比骨干微调，集成推理，处理类别不平衡，获仇恨检测第二名（F1:0.797）和情感分析第四名（F1:0.518）。
summary_en: This paper presents a system for CHiPSAL 2026 Nepali meme hate speech and sentiment analysis, using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with two-stage training (LoRA and contrastive), achieving 2nd place in hate detection (F1:0.797) and 4th in sentiment (F1:0.518).
